title: voyria uniflora
intro: Voyria uniflora, commonly known as the one-flowered Voyria, is a flowering plant species in the Gentian family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Voyria uniflora include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Voyria uniflora have been identified to include gentiopicrin and other triterpenoid compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
